TriviaQA Speech
	

Speech version of TriviaQA eval, where the speech is synthesized using XTTS-v2. Note that there might not be a 1:1 mapping with the original text eval due to TTS failures.

author: mistralai
description:
MM-MT-Bench
	

MM-MT-Bench is a multi-turn LLM-as-a-judge evaluation benchmark similar to the text MT-Bench for testing multimodal instruction-tuned models. While existing benchmarks like MMMU, MathVista, ChartQA and so on are focused on closed-ended questions with short responses, they do not evaluate model's ability to follow user instructions in multi-turn dialogues and answer open-ended questions in a zero-shot manner.
